parts.gloss: lord of the maritime tract / husband

words.gloss: to perish / so that it vanishes

literal: Let come indeed my lord one day; I will drink [his presence] all distress-pain to perish.
translation: Let my lord return for just a single day; I shall drink in his presence so that all this painful sorrow of separation vanishes.
modern: என் தலைவன் ஒருநாள் மட்டும் வரட்டும்; என் துன்ப நோய் முழுவதும் அழியும்படி நான் அவனைக் கண்டு பருகுவேன்.
explanation: In this verse, the heroine expresses her intense longing for her husband's return. She wishes for him to come back for just a single day, which she believes will be enough to cure her. She uses the vivid metaphor of 'drinking' (parukuvaṉ) to describe how eagerly and completely she will consume his presence. This feast of reunion will instantly banish all the painful affliction (paital nōy) caused by their long separation.
